name: Praesidia
description: Govern AI agent and MCP server access with runtime policy, approvals, guardrails and a signed audit trail, through a documented REST API and an auth-gated MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Agent Discovery
skills.description: List registered agents and published agent templates through paginated discovery endpoints on the Praesidia REST API.

skills.name: Tool Policy Enforcement
skills.description: Read and apply tool policies and guardrails that gate which actions a connected agent or MCP server may invoke.

skills.name: Approval Gating
skills.description: Inspect pending and resolved approval records for agent actions that require a human decision before they run.

skills.name: Audit Verification
skills.description: Verify signed audit records using the published SPKI signing keys, JWKS and did:web identity served at well-known endpoints.

skills.name: MCP Invocation
skills.description: Invoke governed agents, tools and workflows over the API-key-gated MCP endpoint under the mcp:invoke scope.
